ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels with sparse high-intensity (white) focal points; estimated ratio of 96:4.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark-intensity base-layer with discrete, roughly circular high-contrast white clusters (approx. 9 units) mapped to the central and upper-central quadrants of both fluke lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a pixel convergence angle of approximately 45 degrees and high vertical depth relative to the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular, high-frequency serration pattern consisting of multiple jagged peaks and valleys along the entire continuous trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex outward curve fitted to the upper trailing margins, terminating in sharp, protruded distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of 9 distinct, circular white ring-shaped pixel clusters distributed across the mid-sections of both lobes (5 left, 4 right).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral calcified biological protrusions (barnacles) localized on the distal tips and sporadically along the trailing edge serrations of the right lobe.
